title: The derived adjunction $Lg^*\dashv Rg_*$
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be as in [def-sfb-finite-derived-pullback-iso] and $g\colon Z\to Y$ a
morphism. The adjunction $g^*\dashv g_*$ of [def-sfb-finite-upper-lower-star-adjunction]
induces an adjunction

$$
Lg^*\dashv Rg_*
$$

between the total derived functors on the unbounded derived categories
[sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]: $Lg^*$ computed on K-flat resolutions of
$D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)$, $Rg_*$ on K-injective resolutions of
$D(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)$.

proof.text:
This is the general derived adjunction for an adjoint pair whose left adjoint is
left derivable and right adjoint right derivable. The unit is
$K\to g_*g^*K$ on a K-flat representative followed by $g_*$ of a K-injective resolution of
$g^*K$; the counit is dual. The required absoluteness conditions hold because the
comparison maps of the derived functors are isomorphisms on K-flat, respectively
K-injective, complexes, and the triangle identities follow from those of $g^*\dashv g_*$.
